“A Nice Derangement of Epitaphs.”

健一郎
「この作品はそう扱われるだろう……」

健一郎
「この作品はそう扱われるだろう……」

Kenichirou
“That is how the world will regard this work.”

Kenichirou
“That is how the world will regard this work.”

健一郎
「だが、それで良い」

“But that is as it should be.”

“But that is as it should be.”

“For this is my epitaph.”

「俺は、じきに死ぬ」

“I shall be dead soon.”

Kenichirou
“I shall be dead soon.”

健一郎
「長かった様で、とても短い様で、いや、それでもやはり長かった……そんな感覚だ」

Kenichirou
“It seemed long, and impossibly short. No—even so, it was long. That is how it feels.”

“When a man pauses here, at the final place, many things become clear.”

Kenichirou

“Thank you.”

“Naoya, that is all I am able to say.”

ja.html:
健一郎

Kenichirou
“I'm glad I went on painting all these years.”

“Yes. I'm glad.”
